newsitem.title: USA: The New York Times says circulation up.
newsitem.headline: The New York Times says circulation up.

text.p: The New York Times said Monday that new northeast editions of the paper, introduced in February, as well as an expanded national edition, contributed to an increase in Sunday circulation in the second quarter, compared to the same period a year ago.
However, The Times added that weekday circulation declined in the second quarter, compared to last year.

The Times said in a statement that in the results from an Interim Publisher's statement filed with the Audit Bureau of Circulations for the second quarter ending in June showed an increase of 2,700 copies in its Sunday circulation to an average 1.6 million over the same period a year ago.
The media company said weekday circulation in the second quarter fell by 2,500 copies to an average 1.08 million.
The times said both results showed a substanial improvement from the six-month figures for the period of Oct 1996 through March 1997.
